correctness.rationale: Petersen KG(5,2) has exactly ten indexed vertices, permitting complete enumeration of all 2^10 subsets. Independent bitset connectivity reconstruction finds 120/65/10 disconnected-complement facets at k=5/6/7 and exactly 496/211/51 faces including empty. Independently reconstructed greedy face-toggle Morse matchings have 241/100/20 pairs, topological-sort acyclicity on the entire oriented Hasse diagram, and critical cells (5 dim3+9 dim4)/(11 dim3)/(11 dim1), plus one vertex. The signed integral 5×9 Morse boundary in the k=5 case has exact rank four with a unit 4×4 minor and explicit row relation, giving four unimodular cancellation pairs and S³∨5S⁴, not merely mod-two homology. k6 and k7 are wedges of eleven spheres of dimensions 3 and 1. Exhaustion confirms k≥8 void. No claim about other graphs.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical finite nonchordal symmetric graph discussed in the foundational cut-complex paper. Completing its three terminal nonvoid ordinary-cut homotopy types gives naturally motivated exact topological invariants, including a mixed-dimensional integral wedge and a sharp nonshellability witness. Being finite does not make this a rote table computation; exhaustive Morse theory is material.
